summary.text: In fall 2022, while Greg Wallis was a candidate for the 47th Assembly District, the Idyllwild Town Crier reported that he was district manager for Assemblyman Chad Mayes, a post he had held for seven years.

paragraphs.text: The 2022 article gave his age as 32 and quoted his campaign website as describing him as a third-generation Californian.

sources.title: Greg Wallis battling for his own Assembly seat - Idyllwild Town Crier
